signature_matches.name: print debug messages
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: print debug messages
    namespace: host-interaction/log/debug/write-event
    authors:
      - michael.hunhoff@mandiant.com
    scopes:
      static: function
      dynamic: call
    examples:
      - 493167E85E45363D09495D0841C30648:0x401000
  features:
    - or:
      - api: DbgPrint
      - api: kernel32.OutputDebugString
      - and:
        - os: android
        - api: __android_log_print

signature_matches.name: implement COM DLL
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: implement COM DLL
    namespace: executable/pe
    authors:
      - moritz.raabe@mandiant.com
    scopes:
      static: file
      dynamic: file
    references:
      - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/combaseapi/nf-combaseapi-dllgetclassobject
  features:
    - and:
      - export: DllGetClassObject
      - optional:
        - export: DllRegisterServer
